sentences.en: As we celebrate this milestone and our 16th Birthday Week, we wanted to revisit not only how we got here, but also how our Impact programs continue to grow and evolve to help those working for the public interest.
sentences.zh: 在我们庆祝这一里程碑和16岁生日周之际，我们不仅想重新审视我们是如何到达这里的，而且还想重新审视我们的影响力计划如何继续发展和发展，以帮助那些为公共利益而努力的人。

sentences.en: Free → Impact Cloudflare started as a free service.
sentences.zh: 免费→ Impact Cloudflare最初是一项免费服务。

sentences.en: The original idea was to provide a basic version of our services to developers and small businesses for free, and then use the data about cyberattacks on their websites to build more sophisticated products that we could sell.

sentences.en: However, we quickly discovered that some of our free customers were not only doing essential work, like reporting on corruption in Africa or on the Russian invasion of Crimea, but also experiencing some of the largest attacks on our network.

sentences.en: We committed not only to making them available for free for everyone, but also to doing more for organizations being targeted by powerful adversaries simply for serving the public.

items.title: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights

sentences.en: Identify AI model overuse with User Insights.
When we launched User Insights last month, we wanted to help teams answer a basic question: What are people actually doing with AI?
User Insights gives teams a clearer view of their AI usage, showing which users, applications, tasks, and models are driving traffic.
It also highlights user and agent anomalies, helping teams identify unexpected or out-of-control spending and usage before they become larger problems.
Our latest update adds something our users have been asking for: context.
Since launch, we’ve heard from users that model names and request counts only tell part of the story.
They show where traffic is going, but reveal little about the work behind it: is that request a code review, a research task, or an agent making several calls to complete a job?
The same token count can represent very different kinds of work, and you can’t evaluate with model choice without understanding the task.
User Insights now shows when a model may be more capable than a task requires, which of your users and agents are driving that usage, and how the task, model, cost, and conversation patterns relate.
Teams can use these insights to investigate and make targeted changes within their organization.
These capabilities are available for free to AI Gateway users.
Why AI usage is hard to understand Consider a team that has routed its internal AI traffic through AI Gateway .

items.title: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid

sentences.en: Pay Per Use: when AI uses your work, you should get paid.
AI answer engines read a publisher’s page and hand the reader a summary, so the visit, and the revenue that would come with it, never happens.
Most publishers will never sign a licensing deal with the companies that use their work in AI products, and no company can negotiate with millions of sites.
The web needs a way to say “yes, if you pay.” Pay Per Use is one way to say it, and it's now in beta.
In July, we outlined our plan for Pay Per Use.
Since then, we’ve been working with buyers and content owners to bring it to life.
The gist: A buyer offers a price for a specific use of your content.
You choose whether to accept.
The buyer reports each use, and Cloudflare bills the buyer and pays you.
Publishers track usage and earnings in the Cloudflare dashboard.
Buyers report usage through a single API.
Pay for the use, not the crawl AI products fetch far more than they use.

items.title: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402

sentences.en: Monetization Gateway beta: charge AI agents for consumption with HTTP 402.
Today, we’re making the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway available as part of a closed beta, and showcasing four customer use cases that are in production today.
Since we announced the plan three months ago, we have been working closely with our customers to make the Gateway fast, flexible, and easy to use.
With just a few clicks, the Monetization Gateway allows domain owners to charge agents for access to their website, APIs, MCP tools, or datasets.
Request access today in the Cloudflare Dashboard .
Proliferation of agents and machine payments Today, most software businesses sell their products through subscriptions or prepaid credits.
These business models require buyers to make a considerable upfront economic investment, so buyers limit themselves to a few subscriptions that fit into their budget.
But this business model doesn’t align itself with how the predominant source of traffic on the Internet — agents — operates.
Agents seek outcomes, whether that’s sourced from a direct question or an implicit elicitation.
To achieve an outcome, an agent may visit new sites, call MCP tools, or ingest data feeds.
Businesses everywhere want to be in the critical path to help agents get better results.
This helps them meet new users where they are, get paid for their inputs to those agents' answers, and take a leading position in headless agentic commerce.

items.title: Simplifying domains for people and agents

sentences.en: Simplifying domains for people and agents.
You just thought of your next great idea, and buying the right domain feels like the easiest way to make that first bit of progress.
Naturally, you open a new tab in your browser, only to find yourself face-to-face with an experience that feels like a budget airline peppering you with add-ons at checkout: Want security?
How about a website?
Do you want email?
You’re just a few minutes into building your next idea, and it doesn’t feel fun anymore.
Launched a decade ago , Cloudflare Registrar has always taken a simpler approach.
Domains at cost, transparent pricing, and no unnecessary upsells.
But simplicity shouldn’t begin at checkout.
It should begin the moment you start looking for the right domain.
Today, we’re bringing that same simplicity to the entire experience of finding and buying a domain.
Our new domain search shows every extension we support , responds as quickly as you type, and makes hundreds of possibilities easier to explore through sorting, filtering, and transparent pricing.

items.title: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent

sentences.en: Detect and send production issues straight to your agent.
As agents help us build more complex applications, both humans and agents need a better way to stay on top of what goes wrong in production.
Coding agents can already query observability data, navigate a repository, change code, write tests, and open a pull request.

What remains manual is connecting those steps: recognizing that repeated failures come from the same bug, gathering the relevant logs and traces, sending that context to an agent, and checking whether the fix worked.
Without that structured handoff, the agent must search raw telemetry to reconstruct the scope and context of the failure before it can investigate.
Today, we are introducing Issues , built-in error monitoring for Cloudflare Workers (now in open beta!)
to streamline this workflow.
Issues can: Group repeated exceptions, 5xx responses, and error logs into one issue.
Send the error, stack trace, logs, traces, and Worker version to a configured coding agent.
Trigger the agent’s configured workflow — from triaging an issue to querying more data to opening a pull request.
Fix your first issue with the following prompt for your agent with CF CLI or checkout the documentation to get started: Copy prompt: Set up for cf Set up cf: https://developers.cloudflare.com/cf/.
Enable Issues for this Worker in cloudflare.config.ts; show the diff and ask before deploying.

items.title: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router

sentences.en: Cut your AI spend with AI Gateway's Auto Router.
From our conversations with companies at every stage of their AI adoption journey, we've seen some common patterns.
First, there is an exploration period as you bring on every new tool, dole out API keys freely, and let the tokens flow.
Then, you converge on the canonical tools for your organization for agentic coding, for non-technical workflows, for running and deploying agents.
As companies formalize their AI adoption, they want to manage and oversee token spend for users, but budgets and rules only go so far.
The best savings are the ones users never notice.
Today, we are releasing Cloudflare's Auto Router in public beta, available through AI Gateway.

Set your model to cloudflare/auto and the Auto Router will automatically route each request to a model that is capable enough for the task, without requiring an end user to think about model selection.
Our early results using the Auto Router internally through our OpenCode harness show a cost savings of up to 30% when compared to using only frontier models like OpenAI Sol and Anthropic Claude Opus.
Why we built this From our own experience tracking AI spend at Cloudflare, we’ve learned managing costs requires a multipronged approach.
Previously, we talked about how to set budgets and limits around AI spend, and how to see who is spending across your organization by linking employees to their AI usage.
In many harnesses, including OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex, individual users still select models manually.

items.title: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes

sentences.en: Cloudflare Containers, rebuilt to scale agent sandboxes.
Today, we’re making Cloudflare Containers more programmable and optimized for agent workloads.
Agents don't deploy sandboxes ahead of time.
They create sandboxes on demand, for each task, expect them to be ready immediately, and be able to pause and resume.

So we rearchitected Containers to meet these requirements: your code can now choose each sandbox's image and instance type at runtime, Containers start 6x faster, and filesystem snapshots are available in public beta.
To make this possible, we’ve rethought the Containers infrastructure from the bottom up.
A new scheduling policy moves control over each sandbox into application code, while a redesigned runtime provides a faster path to a running Container.

In ComputeSDK’s independent benchmark, median startup fell from just over four seconds to 648 milliseconds, and, in our own preliminary tests, burst testing successfully created hundreds of thousands of containers in seconds.

All of this builds on what has always set Containers on Cloudflare apart: every Container gets its own Durable Object, a persistent, programmable controller running right next to it that manages its lifecycle, outbound traffic, and more.

We are bringing more capabilities directly to the native ctx.container API, so the Durable Object can control its Container without a wrapper class in between, and we’re carrying this model into Sandbox SDK 1.0.
As we wrote earlier this year, your agent needs a computer.
These changes make Containers a better complement to Workers, Dynamic Workers, and Durable Objects when agents need a full Linux workspace.

sentences.zh: 马来西亚：联合国机构敦促在难民返回缅甸后采取保障措施。

sentences.en: The UN refugee agency, UNHCR, has voiced concern over Malaysia’s decision to return 1,476 people to Myanmar amid an ongoing civil war and a dire human rights and humanitarian situation.
sentences.zh: 联合国难民署对马来西亚在持续的内战和严峻的人权和人道主义局势中将1,476人遣返缅甸的决定表示关切。

items.title: Homicides fall as organised crime grows more profitable – and networked

sentences.en: Homicides fall as organised crime grows more profitable – and networked.
sentences.zh: 凶杀案随着有组织犯罪的利润增长而下降–并且网络化。

sentences.en: Homicide rates are falling across much of the world, but organised crime is on the rise in many regions as criminal networks diversify into trafficking, migrant smuggling, and the exploitation of natural resources, a new UN report launched on Wednesday revealed.
sentences.zh: 周三发布的一份新的联合国报告显示，世界大部分地区的凶杀率都在下降，但随着犯罪网络多样化，包括贩运、偷运移民和开采自然资源，有组织犯罪在许多地区都在上升。

items.title: Somali families face renewed violence amid worsening hunger crisis

sentences.en: Somali families face renewed violence amid worsening hunger crisis.
sentences.zh: 在饥饿危机加剧的情况下，索马里家庭再次面临暴力。

sentences.en: Children have been killed and injured in fresh fighting in Baidoa, in Somalia’s South West State, where families were already facing severe hunger and other overlapping crises.
sentences.zh: 在索马里西南州拜多阿，儿童在新的战斗中死伤，那里的家庭已经面临严重的饥饿和其他重叠的危机。

items.title: Could a new global panel defuse inequality’s ‘ticking time bomb’?

sentences.en: Could a new global panel defuse inequality’s ‘ticking time bomb’?.
sentences.zh: 一个新的全球小组能否化解不平等的“定时炸弹” ？

sentences.en: What if the world tackled inequality with the same kind of scientific firepower it has brought to the climate crisis?
sentences.zh: 如果世界用它给气候危机带来的同样的科学火力解决不平等问题，那该怎么办？

items.title: World News in Brief: Storm clouds over Gaza, deadly obstacles face Mexican women rights defenders, Latvia booze ban proves lifesaver

sentences.en: World News in Brief: Storm clouds over Gaza, deadly obstacles face Mexican women rights defenders, Latvia booze ban proves lifesaver.
sentences.zh: 《世界新闻简报》：加沙上空笼罩着暴风云，墨西哥女权维护者面临着致命的障碍，拉脱维亚禁酒令证明了她们的救命稻草。

sentences.en: UN teams are racing to protect families in Gaza from the coming rainy season, but restricted access to land and shortages of critical supplies are hampering the effort, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 联合国发言人斯特凡·杜贾里克（ Stéphane Dujarric ）周三表示，联合国团队正在竞相保护加沙的家庭免受即将到来的雨季的影响，但获得土地的限制和重要物资的短缺阻碍了这一努力。

items.title: Who gets to shape AI? UN debate centres on power, trust and inclusion

sentences.en: Who gets to shape AI?
sentences.zh: 谁来塑造人工智能？

sentences.en: UN debate centres on power, trust and inclusion.
sentences.zh: 联合国辩论的核心是权力、信任和包容。

sentences.en: Artificial Intelligence or AI – and the technology behind it – is moving fast.
sentences.zh: 人工智能（ AI ）及其背后的技术正在快速发展。

sentences.en: The question being asked across the world is who gets a seat at the table deciding how it's used and who gets to benefit.
sentences.zh: 全世界都在问的问题是，谁能在谈判桌上占有一席之地，决定如何使用它，谁能从中受益。

items.title: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends

sentences.en: Last UK and US troops leave Iraq as anti-Islamic State mission ends.
sentences.zh: 随着反伊斯兰国任务的结束，最后一支英国和美国军队离开伊拉克。

sentences.en: The withdrawal of coalition forces, under a deal agreed two years ago, was a key demand of the Iraqi government.
sentences.zh: 根据两年前达成的协议，撤出联军是伊拉克政府的一项关键要求。

items.title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests

sentences.en: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests.
sentences.zh: 尽管有土地抗议，非洲首富仍启动了肯尼亚炼油厂。

sentences.en: The Kenya refinery is part of Dangote's ambitious bid to expand and help industralise Africa by 2030.
sentences.zh: 肯尼亚炼油厂是Dangote雄心勃勃的目标的一部分，即到2030年扩大并帮助非洲实现工业化。

items.title: AI tool that copied actor’s ‘lustrous’ voice violated his rights, Tokyo court rules

sentences.en: AI tool that copied actor’s ‘lustrous’ voice violated his rights, Tokyo court rules.
sentences.zh: 根据东京法院的规定，复制演员“光彩照人的”声音的人工智能工具侵犯了他的权利。

sentences.en: Kenjiro Tsuda wins case against TikTok account in landmark Japanese verdict to protect publicity rights A court in Japan has ruled that the human voice has legal protection after a landmark case involving a well-known actor and a TikTok account that he claimed had cloned his “lustrous” baritone voice in its AI-generated videos.
sentences.zh: 津田健二郎在日本一项具有里程碑意义的判决中赢得了针对TikTok账户的诉讼，以保护宣传权。日本一家法院裁定，在一起具有里程碑意义的案件发生后，人的声音受到法律保护，该案件涉及一名知名演员和一个TikTok账户，他声称该账户在人工智能生成的视频中克隆了他“有光泽的”男中音声音。

sentences.en: Tokyo district court said on Wednesday that voices should enjoy the same protection as publicity rights, at the end of a closely watched legal action brought against TikTok by Kenjiro Tsuda – best known for voicing the character Kento Nanami in the anime Jujutsu Kaisen.
sentences.zh: 东京地方法院周三表示，在津田贤二郎对TikTok提起的密切关注的法律诉讼结束时，声音应该享有与宣传权相同的保护，该诉讼以动漫《柔术海战》中的角色Kento Nanami而闻名。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: South Korea calls for apology from North Korea after mine injures three soldiers

sentences.en: South Korea calls for apology from North Korea after mine injures three soldiers.
sentences.zh: 在地雷炸伤三名士兵后，韩国呼吁朝鲜道歉。

sentences.en: Blast during search operation near border fuels political tensions amid attempts to revive diplomatic channels South Korea has demanded an apology from North Korea over a landmine blast that injured three soldiers, saying they were hurt by North Korean mines on the southern side of the border.
sentences.zh: 在试图恢复外交渠道期间，边境附近的搜索行动引发了政治紧张局势。韩国要求朝鲜就三名士兵受伤的地雷爆炸事件道歉，称他们在边境南侧被朝鲜地雷炸伤。

sentences.en: Kang Hyun-woo, the director of operations at South Korea’s joint chiefs of staff, demanded an apology and “responsible measures” from Pyongyang over the blast, which occurred on 21 September during a search operation south of the border.
sentences.zh: 韩国参谋长联席会议行动主任姜贤宇（ Kang Hyun-woo ）要求平壤就9月21日在边境以南的一次搜索行动中发生的爆炸事件道歉并采取“负责任的措施”。

items.title: Build with Azure Canvases: a shared workspace for agents

sentences.en: Build with Azure Canvases: a shared workspace for agents.
sentences.zh: 使用Azure Canvases生成：代理的共享工作区。

sentences.en: Introducing Azure canvases for GitHub Copilot Azure work often spans discovery, analysis, and action.
sentences.zh: 介绍GitHub Copilot Azure工作的Azure画布通常涵盖发现、分析和操作。

sentences.en: With Azure canvases for GitHub Copilot, those steps can happen in an interactive workspace alongside your conversation with Copilot.
sentences.zh: 使用适用于GitHub Copilot的Azure画布，这些步骤可以在与Copilot对话的同时在交互式工作区中进行。

sentences.en: Instead of managing results entirely in chat, you can browse resources, explore cost data, and guide a workflow in a purpose-built interface while Copilot remains available to help.
sentences.zh: 您可以在专门构建的界面中浏览资源、浏览成本数据并指导工作流程，而不是完全在聊天中管理结果，同时Copilot仍然可以提供帮助。

sentences.en: Today, we’re publishing three Azure canvases through the Awesome Copilot marketplace .
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将通过Awesome Copilot市场发布三个Azure画布。

sentences.en: Make Azure work interactive Canvas extensions bring interactive tools such as dashboards, editors, and guided workflows directly into the GitHub Copilot app.
sentences.zh: 使Azure交互式工作Canvas扩展将仪表板、编辑器和引导式工作流等交互式工具直接带入GitHub Copilot应用。

sentences.en: You and your agent share a workspace where you can see progress, make changes, and approve next steps without digging through chat history.
sentences.zh: 您和您的客服代表共享一个工作区，您可以在其中查看进度、进行更改和批准后续步骤，而无需浏览聊天历史记录。

sentences.en: Routine interactions, such as filtering a table or selecting an option, can run directly in code rather than requiring another model call.
sentences.zh: 常规交互（例如筛选表或选择选项）可以直接在代码中运行，而不需要另一个模型调用。

sentences.en: That means less waiting and fewer AI credits spent on simple tasks, while keeping the agent available when you need its help.
sentences.zh: 这意味着更少的等待和更少的人工智能积分花费在简单的任务上，同时在需要帮助时保持代理可用。

sentences.en: To learn more about canvases, see How canvases make agentic workflows visible, steerable, and cost-efficient .
sentences.zh: 要了解有关画布的更多信息，请参阅画布如何使代理工作流程可见、可引导且经济高效。

sentences.en: Meet the Azure canvases Canvas Use it to Azure Functions Hosted Skills Build, run, and deploy hosted skills with Azure Functions.
sentences.zh: 了解Azure画布Canvas使用Azure Functions托管技能使用Azure Functions生成、运行和部署托管技能。

sentences.en: Azure Resources Query Browse a read-only view of resources across selected subscriptions.
sentences.zh: Azure资源查询在所选订阅中浏览资源的只读视图。

items.title: Enabling Consistent AI-Assisted Engineering with GitHub Copilot Plugins

sentences.en: Enabling Consistent AI-Assisted Engineering with GitHub Copilot Plugins.
sentences.zh: 使用GitHub Copilot插件实现一致的人工智能辅助工程。

sentences.en: When an engineer or team creates useful agentic artifacts for their daily work (e.g., instructions, skills, and MCP configurations), others naturally want to adopt them when they see how those artifacts could help with their own work.
sentences.zh: 当工程师或团队为他们的日常工作创建有用的代理工件（例如，说明、技能和MCP配置）时，当其他人看到这些工件如何帮助他们自己的工作时，他们自然希望采用它们。

sentences.en: Sharing the files is straightforward, but keeping those consumers supplied with fixes, updated guidance, and compatible tool configurations requires a way to maintain and distribute those artifacts.
sentences.zh: 共享文件很简单，但要让这些消费者获得修复程序、更新的指南和兼容的工具配置，需要一种维护和分发这些制品的方法。

sentences.en: That challenge shaped our work with a large enterprise customer as we designed and built a migration and modernization toolkit together.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战塑造了我们与大型企业客户的合作，因为我们共同设计和构建了一个迁移和现代化工具包。

sentences.en: Their internal and third-party engineering teams needed a consistent way to apply the customer’s architecture guidance, tools, and delivery practices while modernizing thousands of applications.
sentences.zh: 他们的内部和第三方工程团队需要一种一致的方式来应用客户的架构指导、工具和交付实践，同时实现数千个应用程序的现代化。

sentences.en: We packaged and distributed those capabilities through GitHub Copilot plugins , and we’ll walk through the choices we made, the trade-offs behind them, and how you can adapt the approach to your own engineering workflows.
sentences.zh: 我们通过GitHub Copilot插件打包并分发了这些功能，我们将介绍我们做出的选择、这些选择背后的权衡，以及如何根据自己的工程工作流程调整方法。

sentences.en: This work applied platform engineering practices to AI-assisted engineering workflows.
sentences.zh: 这项工作将平台工程实践应用于人工智能辅助工程工作流程。

sentences.en: We maintained shared capabilities as a versioned toolkit that teams could install in their existing development environments, while keeping application-specific context and decisions in their repositories.
sentences.zh: 我们将共享功能维护为团队可以安装在现有开发环境中的版本化工具包，同时在其存储库中保留特定于应用程序的上下文和决策。

sentences.en: Making adoption and updates manageable We needed to distribute these artifacts together, with a way for maintainers to release changes and engineers to adopt them.
sentences.zh: 使采用和更新易于管理我们需要将这些工件一起分发，让维护人员发布更改并让工程师采用它们。

sentences.en: Copying files into each application repository would leave teams responsible for reconciling shared updates with their local changes.
sentences.zh: 将文件复制到每个应用程序存储库中将使团队负责协调共享更新与本地更改。

sentences.en: GitHub Copilot plugins gave us an installable, versioned package for those artifacts.
sentences.zh: GitHub Copilot插件为我们提供了一个可安装的、版本化的工件包。

sentences.en: We also wanted to avoid building and maintaining our own mechanism for packaging and loading these artifacts.
sentences.zh: 我们还希望避免构建和维护我们自己的打包和加载这些制品的机制。
